comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
"Relic Chaser - A title for voyagers who have rich experience exploring ruins. It increases the probability that advantageous devices will trigger for you."

New title available as of Gran Atlas chapter 1; gained after 1000 (or higher) ruin exploration rate. Should come in handy with the revamped dungeon system.

comments.author: jperana
comments.body: Does this inherit the benefits of Relic Hunter?

comments.author: Curious
comments.body: Chicken Chaser, now that's a true hero!

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
@jp: I think the dungeon title benefits are independent of each other. Kind of like how Deepseeker, the new Labyrinth title, doesn't seem to have the Relic Hunter/Chaser title effects of extra goodies/devices triggering more often. That's been my own personal experience, at least.

@C: What does Fatty Arbuckle's 1914 silent film have to do with heroism?

comments.author: Curious
comments.body: It was actually meant to be a Fable reference lol

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: Oh, okay. That does make more sense. Cheers, then!
